name: Field Display Label
description: Defines a label for fields that is used for displaying content which can be different than the form label.
project_description:
This module provides a different label for displaying fields from the label used when viewing the field in a form. For example, if you want the field to display label "Body" when editing content, but to display label "Body Display" when viewing the content.

 CONFIGURATION 
 1. Go to Administration/Structure/Content types/YOU CONTENT TYPE/Manage fields.

2. Edit any field.

3. Fill in "Display label" with displaying label.
